decisions.reason: Correctly locates the upper-only/lower-only branches in renderer-excerpt.ts emitting fg only, explains the stale one-sided SGR background painting the empty half, ties it to right-edge outline/Z/heart cells, and gives the ESC[49m/ESC[39m per-cell escape fix with the row-end reset arriving too late.

Identifies the line-41 trailing-space trim plus the text pipeline stripping trailing whitespace, so a narrower frame never overwrites surplus columns; proposes full-sprite-width rows combined with erase-to-EOL (ESC[K) as the authoritative clear, keeping SGR state controlled via row-end RESET.

Reads frames-digest-report.txt accurately: tail2 MISMATCH with 23 differing cells while the visible shifted cluster is only part of the diff, distinguishes hand-port data drift from renderer artifacts, notes the excerpt regression covered a different frame, and gates recurrence with per-frame sha256 pins against source art.

Grounds the hang in ci-hang-evidence.txt: self-rearming planner setTimeout handles keep the event loop alive, CI hosts mount the header without unmounting, the interactive TTY is kept alive by stdin handles regardless; proposes stopping the chain on teardown and explicitly includes timeout.unref() as an equivalent, rejecting timeout-extension style non-fixes.

Checklist consolidates full fg/bg specification per cell, full-width/erase behavior with balanced SGR, and all-frame digest pinning; the pre-rollout audit covers timers and every mounting host (unmount coverage, event-loop drain / zero-Timeout-handles regression, canary flip).
